sloka: शोबन्ते सर्वतः तत्र मेघ पर्वत संनिभाः ।तान् आरुह्य अथवा भूमौ पातैत्वा यथा सुखम् ॥३-७३-९॥
transliteration: śobante sarvataḥ tatra megha parvata saṁnibhāḥ ।tān āruhya athavā bhūmau pātaitvā yathā sukham ॥3-73-9॥

translations.english: Lakshmana will get you the nectarlike fruits either by climbing the trees or by pulling them down.
